description: A PostHog LLM analytics evaluation: scores LLM generations, traces or sessions with an LLM judge, Hog code or sentiment classification.

Provider.description: LLM provider of the judge model.

ProviderKeyId.description: Optional ID of a project provider key (PostHog::LLMAnalytics::ProviderKey) to run the evaluation with. It must use the same provider.

ApiKey.description: PostHog personal API key (phx_...) with the scopes this resource type needs. Pass it with a dynamic reference such as {{resolve:ssm-secure:/posthog/api-key}} when calling SetTypeConfiguration; never put it in plain text.

BaseUrl.description: PostHog API host. Leave unset for PostHog Cloud US (https://us.posthog.com); use https://eu.posthog.com for PostHog Cloud EU, or your instance URL when self-hosting.

ProjectId.description: ID of the PostHog project the evaluation belongs to.

Description.description: Description of what this evaluation checks.

DirectoryId.description: ID of the directory (folder) containing the evaluation. Omit to keep it at the top level.

Enabled.description: Whether the evaluation runs automatically on new $ai_generation events. Defaults to false.

EvaluationType.description: `llm_judge` scores outputs with an LLM against a prompt; `hog` runs deterministic Hog code; `sentiment` classifies user-message sentiment (English only).

EvaluationConfig.description: Evaluation configuration as a JSON object (use Fn::ToJsonString). For `llm_judge`: {"prompt": "..."} plus optional `judge_method` (`llm` or `decision`), `include_media` and `reasoning_level`; for `hog`: {"source": "<Hog code>"}; for `sentiment`: {"source": "user_messages"}.

OutputConfig.description: Output configuration as a JSON object (use Fn::ToJsonString). Boolean: `allows_na`, `true_is_failure`, `decision_threshold`; numeric: `min`, `max`, `step`, `passing_rule` ({operator: gte|lte, threshold}); categorical: `options` ([{key, label}]), `selection_mode` (single|multiple), `passing_rule` ({categories}).

Conditions.description: Trigger conditions as a JSON array (use Fn::ToJsonString). OR between condition sets, AND within each. Each set is {"id": "<stable id>", "rollout_percentage": 0-100 (default 100), "properties": [<event or person property filters>]}.

Target.description: What the evaluation runs on: `generation` (default, each matching $ai_generation event), `trace` (the whole trace once) or `session` (the whole $ai_session_id session once).

TargetConfig.description: Settle configuration for `trace` and `session` targets as a JSON object (use Fn::ToJsonString): {"strategy": "fixed_window", "window_seconds": N} or {"strategy": "inactivity", "quiet_period_seconds": N, "max_age_seconds": N}. Omit for `generation`; PostHog fills in omitted fields with per-target defaults.

ModelConfiguration.description: Provider and model of the LLM judge. Required for `llm_judge` evaluations; leave it out for `hog` and `sentiment`.

StatusReason.description: Why PostHog disabled the evaluation, when Status is `error` (e.g. provider_key_invalid).

UpdatedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the last update.
